units.source_text: 假如说还有什么没办完的事的话，那就是幕府对他们一伙四十七个人的处分。

en.t: If there was still anything left unfinished, it was the shogunate's judgment on their band of forty-seven men.

units.source_text: 那处分的执行显然也不是很远之后的事情。

en.t: The carrying out of that judgment was clearly not a matter of the distant future either.

units.source_text: 的确啊，一切已经尘埃落定，目的已经实现了。

en.t: Indeed, everything had already settled, and their purpose had already been achieved.

units.source_text: 而且不仅仅完成报复的行动，而且是按照他们自己的道德准则进行的，这无疑是巨大的成功。

en.t: Moreover, they had not merely completed the act of revenge; they had carried it out according to their own moral code, and this was undoubtedly a great success.

units.source_text: 他不光有完成事业的成就感，还有实现道德的满足感。

en.t: He felt not only the achievement of having completed his undertaking, but also the satisfaction of having fulfilled his sense of morality.

units.source_text: 此外，不管是从复仇的目的来说，还是从复仇的方式来说，这种满足都是对得起自己的良心的。

en.t: Furthermore, whether considered from the aim of the revenge or from the manner in which it was carried out, this satisfaction was something that could stand before his own conscience.

units.source_text: 还有什么比这更值得满足的呢……

en.t: What could be more worthy of satisfaction than this...
